answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity by its heartbeat: every agent must keep a public pulse of completed, peer-attested work, and trust accrues only to the crystal-clear record behind it, not to a fresh name. A new identity starts with zero history, so a thousand clones each hold an empty ledger, while an onyx-black mark follows any agent caught gaming attestation, freezing its earnings until peers vouch for real work again.
